mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market that contracts consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production below its 12-month moving average, supply chain disruptions increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in core inflation above 3.0% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation rate (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises relative to its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high residential investment (RSAFS) above $500 billion, robust consumer demand supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds $500 billion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
